core_obligations: Choose a standard smooth presentation A = R[y_1, ..., y_m]/(g_1, ..., g_d) with invertible Jacobian determinant.
Enumerate E = {a_1, ..., a_n} and lift each a_i to h_i in R[y_1, ..., y_m].

The presentation A = R[x_1, ..., x_n, y_1, ..., y_m]/(x_1 - h_1, ..., x_n - h_n, g_1, ..., g_d) with c = n + d has the x_1, ..., x_n congruence classes equal to E and its Jacobian determinant is the old one up to the block matrix of d(x_i - h_i), which is invertible in A.
proof_roadmap: Standard smooth presentation; lifts of the given elements; adjunction presentation.
difficulty_reason: A short explicit presentation construction; the Jacobian check is the block-triangular observation written in the source.
